note: NHL '94 (SNES) sound entries <-> General MIDI. Every row rests on measurements: one probe note per sound entry played through the game's own SPC700 program (data/audio/nhl94s-sound-analysis.json, rebuilt by tools/build-snes-gm-analysis.js), the sample names the disassembly gives, and how the retail songs use each entry. Each row has a confidence and a runner-up. Nothing was auditioned: edit by ear. Game-set sound effects (passes, shots, pucks, ...) are not instruments and are not mapped. 'program' is a GM program (0-127), 'drum' a GM drum note; 'preferred' marks the entry MIDI import picks for that program.
